contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Yes, YesStyle has an app for Android and iPhone, with the same account as the website. In the app, CECILIA010, a Reward Code, goes in the "Influencer / Rewards Code" field at checkout, next to "Coupon Code". Shipping depends on the country of your address.

contentSections.heading: Where to download the app
paragraphs: YesStyle says the app should only be downloaded from the two official links. Do not install it from anywhere else.
In the app stores, on October 28, 2026:
postParagraphs: The app runs on iOS and Android, according to the store's help center. The home opens on the Korean beauty storefront, with the Home, Shop, Bag, Saved and Account tabs at the bottom.

contentSections.heading: Shipping
paragraphs: Shipping depends on the country of your address, in the app as on the website. Delivery times, costs and customs for each country are in [YesStyle shipping to the US, UK, Canada and Australia](/en/reviews/yesstyle-shipping-us-uk-canada-australia).

contentSections.heading: How to shop in the app
paragraphs: The purchase follows the same order as the website: log in, fill the bag, go to checkout. Three points the store's help center confirms:
bullets: The account is the same as on the website. No need to create another one.
Log in before adding items to the bag. Logged in on both the website and the app, the bag is one and the same.
At checkout, the app shows the shipping country, the shipping cost and the "Coupon or Influencer / Rewards Code" line before the order summary.
postParagraphs: The step by step for the website, with the Reward Code field in the web version, is in [How to use CECILIA010 on YesStyle](/en/reviews/yesstyle-reward-code-coupon-cecilia010). Here we cover only what is specific to the app.

contentSections.heading: Where CECILIA010 goes in the app
paragraphs: CECILIA010 is a Reward Code, not a coupon: it gives up to 5% extra (5% on the first order and 2% on later ones) and stacks with YesStyle's coupons. In the app, it has its own field. Tested in the Android app on October 28, 2026, on an account in English shipping to the United States.
bullets: At checkout, tap "Enter Code" on the "Coupon or Influencer / Rewards Code" line.
Two fields open: "Coupon Code" at the top, for the store's coupon, and "Influencer / Rewards Code" below. Type CECILIA010 in the lower one and tap "APPLY".
Back at checkout, the code appears as a tag under "Coupon or Influencer / Rewards Code", and the summary gains the "Influencer Code Discount" line. Check that line before paying.
postParagraphs: The store's coupon, when one is active, goes in the top field on the same screen. The two stack.

contentSections.heading: YS Points and the app coupon
paragraphs: Logging in through the app earns 50 YS Points, once. Reinstalling does not earn them again. The points are not the Reward Code: they apply at the "Payment Information" step of checkout, while CECILIA010 goes on the "Enter Code" screen. One does not replace the other.

The store says it releases, once a month at a random time, a 24-hour coupon valid only on orders placed in the app; at our check on October 28, 2026, none was active, and the coupon featured in the app was the same as on the website. The store's active coupons are on the [YesStyle page](/en/coupons/yesstyle).

contentSections.heading: If the app does not work
bullets: Download only from the official App Store and Google Play links.
Use your website account. Do not create a new account for the app.
Log in before adding items to the bag. Without logging in, the app's bag does not merge with the website's.
postParagraphs: On the store's safety, [Is YesStyle legit and safe?](/en/reviews/is-yesstyle-legit-and-safe-review) has the answer.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Does YesStyle have an app? Yes, for Android and iPhone, at the official Google Play and App Store links. The store says to download it only from those two.

Does CECILIA010 work in the app? Yes. At checkout, tap "Enter Code" and type the code in the "Influencer / Rewards Code" field. It is a Reward Code, worth up to 5% extra, and it stacks with the store's coupon, which goes in the "Coupon Code" field.
Does the app ship to my country? Shipping depends on the country of your address, in the app as on the website. The shipping guide covers the US, UK, Canada and Australia.
Do I earn points for downloading the app? Yes, 50 YS Points when you log in through the app, once. Reinstalling does not earn them again, and the points are not the Reward Code.
Does the app have an exclusive coupon? The store says it publishes a 24-hour coupon, once a month, only for orders placed in the app. On October 28, 2026, none was active.
